evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/privacy/pages/PrivacySettingsPage.tsx (Epic 63, GDPR Screening & Consent Management) is a WIRED, production, customer-facing page (privacy is NOT in UNWIRED_FEATURES) yet ships ZERO i18n: `grep -rln useTranslation features/privacy/` returns nothing and every user-facing string is hardcoded English — including legally-sensitive GDPR copy: 'Privacy & Data Settings', 'Manage your privacy preferences and data in accordance with GDPR.' (:161), 'Delete Account' (:276), the deletion warning 'This action cannot be undone after the grace period.' (:283), profile-visibility option labels (:205-207), and the account-deletion prompt body (:120-123). ppt-web ships sk/cs/de/en, so Slovak/Czech/German users see English-only GDPR legal text. Separately, raw backend bodies are surfaced directly as the user-facing error: `err.message` from thrown `new Error(response.text())` (loadSettings :52, save :88, export :112, deletion :143-149) can leak server internals/stack text to end users. Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): route all strings through react-i18next t('privacy.*') keys across en/sk/cs/de bundles, and map known error statuses to translated catalogue copy instead of echoing the raw HTTP body. Net-new: no `privacy` id in prior ppt-web-ui signals or backlog.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/sentiment/pages/SentimentDashboardPage.tsx (Epic 13 Story 13.2, WIRED at routes/lazyRoutes.tsx:317) is a presentational dashboard whose props interface (SentimentDashboardPageProps, :12-21) exposes ONLY loading flags (dashboardLoading/trendsLoading/alertsLoading) and NO error prop/branch. The route wrapper in routes/groups/core.tsx wires the TanStack Query hooks but has no error channel to pass through, and the component renders no isError/ErrorBoundary fallback. On any query failure the KPI tiles render MISLEADING values indistinguishable from real data: avgScore -> 'N/A' (:64), 'Data points' -> 0 (:70), and critically 'Open alerts' -> 0 with tone 'default' (:72-73) — i.e. a failed fetch silently reports 'zero open sentiment alerts' on an alerts-monitoring surface, masking real open alerts from managers with no error indication and no retry. Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): add dashboardError/trendsError/alertsError props, surface an error state + retry when any query fails, and render '—'/'N/A' distinctly from a loaded zero. Net-new: prior sentiment signals target features/sentiment/hooks/useSentiment.ts (auth-token wiring in ppt-web-core), not this page's missing error UI.
